description_sq:
Ne zonen e Astirit posedojme per shitje nje apartament te tipologjise 2+1. 
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje ndertim modern te vitit 2024.
Ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 101m2 dhe te brendshme 85m2.
Ndodhet ne katin e 2-te banim dhe orgamizohet ne 2 dhoma gjumi , sallon dhe 1 tualet. 
Apartamenti eshte i investuar me punime ekstra. 
Per me shume informacion ose per nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni!
description_en: In the area of ​​Astir, we have for sale a 2+1 apartment. The apartment is located in a modern building of 2024. It has a total surface of 101m2 and an interior of 85m2. It is located on the 2nd residential floor and is organized into 2 bedrooms, living room and 1 bathroom. The apartment is invested with extra works. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact us!
